slides.texte_overlay:
How to become extremely
good at flirting in your 20s.
• Be relaxed, not intense. Flirting is light and fun. The less pressure you put on it, the better it goes. Keep it playful.
• Smile with your eyes. A warm, genuine smile says more than any clever sentence. Let it come naturally, without forcing anything.
• Share something real about yourself. A small story or a passion. Openness invites openness. Be yourself.
• Notice her reactions. Leaning in and laughing means she's enjoying it. Short answers mean give her space. Read the room.
• Have interesting things to talk about. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and conversations never feel flat.
slides.texte_sophia: • I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Conversations never feel flat.

slides.texte_overlay: • Respect every answer. If she's not interested, smile and move on. Respect is attractive in itself. Always.
Flirting well isn't a skill to trick someone. It's simply being fun, honest and kind with someone you like. Start there.
